Myanmar supplied atleast 60% of China’s rare-earth imports from 2017

As Myanmar burns, China’s access to these resources helps sustain a war economy
Cutting off conflict-linked rare earth imports to China is the only way to end this conflict

India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway is a key project that connect Moreh in Manipur with Mae Sot in Thailand through Myanmar. 
This is a crucial project under India’s act east policy, countering China’s expanding presence in the region

Women and girls trafficked from Myanmar’s Kachin are forced into fraudulent marriages to Chinese men arranged by deceptive brokers. Some children are being forced into labor and other purposes. 

All of this is happening under the watch of the ‘benevolent middle kingdom’
